title: Inflammatory Pain

positions.as_written: Ask how long the knee is stiff in the morning before it loosens, pressing for minutes.
Ask whether it is worse after sitting still and better after moving about, which is the core inflammatory pattern.
Ask about other joints, including the hands, feet and spine, and about swelling in them rather than only pain.
Ask about systemic features: fatigue, fever, weight loss, rashes, eye problems, bowel symptoms and psoriasis.
Ask about family history, since several of the relevant conditions cluster.
